title: Hoshino Ichika — My Feelings, Your Heart〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day of the STANDOUT show

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All of us froze up when she asked us that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You too, Ichika.
We still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True, but I couldn't just sit around at home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't stay still and wait knowing that we have to tell Shiho how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They're both smiling, but probably feel just as nervous as I do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I suppose we should. We're about to unleash a flood of emotions in terms of how we truly feel on her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've kept her waiting long enough...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope she'll hear us out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, but...
What if she's already decided to leave Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We still have to tell her.
She needs to know how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The show's up this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can we table that idea for now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to go pro and play music that can touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a part of me that was hoping we'd all be able to pursue that dream together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But not all of you want to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's always wanted to play for people and find a way to touch their hearts, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, there's no way I can ever be that good. There are just so many great musicians out there too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Even if it's not entirely possible for me to become one, I can at least help her get close to the level she wants to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never actually thought that I could. I kept admiring from afar without actually trying.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That mindset is what kept hurting Shiho...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That lack of resolve kept her waiting...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hey! That looks like the venue!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We have to tell her how we feel now...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Please, Shiho, we beg you...!
Just wait a little longer...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Give us a chance to tell you!
